# Moonraker 3D Printers

Read 3D-printer status and manage requested print jobs through an existing Moonraker service (Klipper) using Muse Home Link, for a commissioned printer and print files already available to the printer. Starting a print requires an explicitly selected existing file and confirmation that the build area and printer are ready; there is no arbitrary G-code, no firmware setup and no configuration changes, and thermal/motion protections are never bypassed.

- Listing: https://theskillharbor.com/products/gadget-moonraker-3d-printers

## Install with Muse

1. Open the listing page above.
2. Copy the install package from the page.
3. Paste it into Muse and follow the steps there.

Installs on Skill Harbor are copy-paste into Muse, never automatic.
